about: Putting Caps Lock back after a Slated that didn't quit cleanly: what hidutil's UserKeyMapping becomes, given what it holds now and Slated's record (caps-lock-mapping.json, as raw text; null when there is none). expected null means hidutil is left alone. Checked against HIDRemapper (Tests/SlatedTests/HIDRemapperTests.swift) and scripts/restore-caps-lock.py (Tests/Installer/test_restore_caps_lock.py). Usages: Caps Lock 30064771129, F18 30064771181, Escape 30064771113, left Control 30064771296, section 30064771172, grave 30064771125.

cases.name: Slated's entry goes, the user's own Caps Lock -> Escape comes back, other entries stay
nothing was on Caps Lock before Slated: its entry just goes
without Slated's record, Caps Lock -> F18 is another tool's: left alone
another tool's Caps Lock -> F18, replaced by Slated's, comes back
a record without Slated's entry is out of date (mappings don't survive a restart)
a Caps Lock entry someone made after Slated's is left alone
an unreadable record still says the entry is Slated's, with nothing to put back
